maintenance_led.reason: Sells custom prototype and production parts (injection molding, CNC, 3D printing, sheet metal) for new product development, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private product companies in automotive, electronics, medical and aerospace buying custom parts; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by digital manufacturing, quoting platform and partner network expansion; acquisitions have been occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Quick-turn custom parts are quoted online and can be sourced from other manufacturers; switching is relatively easy for most prototype orders.

notes: Some medical and aerospace production parts are certified, which may raise switching costs for that part of the business.
